title: Claude Code Hooks: Block rm -rf Before It Runs
description:
Your AI agent can run any command, unless a hook says no. 🛑

✅ Write a short block.sh script that checks the command
✅ Exit 2 to block rm -rf and show Claude why
✅ Register it as a PreToolUse hook on Bash

Day 3 of Safe AI Agents! Next up, Day 4: Run Your Agent in a Sandbox.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to lock down your AI coding agents.

#shorts #claudecode #aicoding #aiagents #aisecurity #anthropic #programming
comment: Hooks or deny rules: which would you set first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: a hook script must be executable (chmod +x), and the jq tool must be installed for the script to read the command.
